question: As of January 2021, who among the following is the Union Minister of Rural Development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Singh Tomar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Rural Development is entrusted with the task of accelerating the socio-economic development of rural India.
 
• As of January 2021, **Narendra Singh Tomar**__ was the Union Minister of Rural Development.
 
• He served as the Union Minister of Rural Development from 2016 to 2021.
 
• He was assigned the additional charge of the **Ministry of Food Processing Industries **after Harsimrat Kaur Badal resigned from the post.
 
• Narendra Singh Tomar is the current Minister of **Agriculture & Farmers Welfare** in the Second Modi ministry.
 
• He was re-elected to the Lok Sabha from **Morena constituency** in 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Amit Shah is currently serving as the Minister of Home Affairs.
 
• S Jaishankar is the current Minister of External Affairs of the Government of India.
 
• Rajnath Singh is the current Defence Minister of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• As of July 2021, **Giriraj Singh** is the Union Minister of Rural Development.
